Morcilla Blood Sausage
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 1:45pm

Ingredients




12 links blood sausage
1 tablespoon olive oil
Coarse salt
Freshly-ground black pepper

Preparation

1 Place sausages on the heated grill. Brush with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until done, 10 to 15 minutes. 2 Serves 10. 3 Comments: The key to successful, tender grilling is maintaining the coals at a low, even temperature. To help control the heat, routinely sprinkle the coals with saltwater when they become too hot. This cools the flame and helps to flavor the cooking meat. A mason jar with holes poked through the lid makes an easy "sprinkler" for the fire.
